 E. ख the sky, तमाल a tree with
dark blossoms; the etherial Tamāla.

खात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Dug, excavated.
 2. Torn, rent.
 n. (-टं)
 1. A square
or oblong pond.
 2. Any excavation.
 E. खन् to dig, affix क्त and
the pen. lengthened.

खातक m. (-कः)
 1. A delver, a digger.
 2. A debtor; more correctly
खादक.
 n. (-कं) A moat, a ditch.
 E. खात a pond, affix कन्.

खातभू f. (-भूः) A moat, a ditch.
 E. खात a pond, भू earth.

खात्र n. (-त्रं)
 1. A square or large pond.
 2. A spade, a hoe.
 3. A wood
4. A thread.
 E. खन् to dig, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
